title: ProblemDetail
description: application/problem+json error response contract for the payment-quality-lab API. Fields vary by error handler: GlobalExceptionHandler returns type/title/status/detail/correlationId/error; PaymentExceptionHandler additionally returns code/message/details.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type

title.description: Human-readable summary of the problem type

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence

message.description: Alternative message field used by some error handlers

error.description: Machine-readable error code (snake_case). Use ProblemCodes constants.

code.description: Uppercase error code alias, present in PaymentExceptionHandler responses

correlationId.description: Correlation ID echoed from X-Correlation-ID request header (or generated by backend)

details.description: Field-level validation errors (array) or additional metadata (object). Type varies by handler.

_note: Schema is intentionally permissive (additionalProperties: true) while backends are evolving. Tighten required fields and additionalProperties once error shapes are stabilised across all controllers.
